description: This PHP source file defines the Contact class used in the SuiteCRM project, representing a contact entity with properties, methods for data retrieval, relationships, and list management. It extends the Person class and implements EmailInterface, including functions for database queries, relationship handling, and export logic.
external_methods: Parent::methodName (various parent class methods are invoked)

classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Represents a contact in the SuiteCRM system, extending Person, with properties for contact details, relationships, and methods for data querying, list management, and synchronization with external systems.

methods.name: add_list_count_joins
methods.description: Adds necessary JOIN statements to a query for counting related account records.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides access control logic for list views, determining visibility of account information based on ACL.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Constructs a custom SQL query for listing contacts, including filters and ordering.

methods.name: address_popup_create_new_list_query
methods.description: Builds a specific list query used in address popup actions.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates an SQL query for exporting contact data.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills extra list view fields like full name and email display strings.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional contact details, including account info and reporting hierarchy.

methods.name: load_contacts_users_relationship
methods.description: Loads the relationship between contacts and users for synchronization purposes.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for display in list views, including synchronization checkbox info.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a WHERE clause for search queries based on user input.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Assigns contact data to notification templates.

methods.name: get_contact_id_by_email
methods.description: Retrieves a contact's ID based on an email address.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves changes to relationships, especially account linkage.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Builds query for unlinked emails associated with the contact.

methods.name: process_sync_to_outlook
methods.description: Handles syncing contact information to Outlook for specified users or groups.
